title: How many degrees are in a straight angle and a right angle?
description: A circle is cut into three hundred and sixty equal parts, each called one degree, and the full turn is used to find the measure of a straight angle and of a right angle. Keeko's doubt, that a straight angle is three hundred and sixty degrees, is broken by showing that it is only half of the full turn.
teaching_notes: One idea: a straight angle is half of a full turn and a right angle is half of a straight angle. Watch for children who give the whole turn as the measure of a straight angle.

source: What is the measure of a straight angle in degrees? What is
video_script.why: The child finds the degree measures of a straight angle and a right angle from the full turn of three hundred and sixty degrees.
video_script.substitution: The book's circle divided into three hundred and sixty equal parts.
video_script.anchor: the book's circle divided at its centre into 360 equal parts, each part one degree
video_script.wrong_answer: a straight angle is three hundred and sixty degrees
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says a straight angle is three hundred and sixty degrees. That is the whole turn back to the start, but a straight angle is only half a turn, so the bubble is struck.
video_script.payoff_line: A straight angle measures one hundred and eighty degrees. A right angle measures ninety degrees.

final_answer.value: straight angle = 180 degrees; right angle = 90 degrees
final_answer.spoken: a straight angle measures one hundred and eighty degrees and a right angle measures ninety degrees

maths_rules: a full turn is divided into 360 equal parts, each part is 1 degree, so a full turn = 360 degrees
a straight angle is half of a full turn: 360 / 2 = 180 degrees
two right angles together form a straight angle, so a right angle is half of a straight angle: 180 / 2 = 90 degrees
a straight angle is half a turn, not the whole turn, so it is not 360 degrees

<bookmark mark='full'/>A full turn holds all the parts, so a full turn is three hundred and sixty degrees.
